jobs.prompt: Write docs/board-approve.md (new file, nothing else) describing the board Approve and Deny design for a project owner: what the owner can answer from the board and phone, what is never answerable there (merge, deploy, publish, cap raise, force-push, branch -D, overrides, unmet acceptance), pairing with a one-time word, device tokens stored only as hashes, one-time decision ids bound to item, device and machine, the confirm step and csrf, replay and expiry refusals, and the audit log; say clearly that only the core module exists and the board buttons and server wiring are planned. Read tools/board-approve.mjs and tests/board-approve.test.mjs for the facts; do not invent behavior. Plain, short sentences, under 120 lines.
